title: Rest the mind on what already carries it
summary: Peace enters when the mind rests on the One sustaining it. Choose settlement before more motion.
lifeApplication: At the sink, desk, or bedside, stop reaching for the next stimulus and feel the breath enter on its own. Let support be received before the mind starts performing again.

source.shortMeaning: Peace enters when the mind rests on the One sustaining it.
source.lifeApplication: When the mind overworks, return to the breath and the One already upholding it.

evidence.coreClaim: Peace enters when the mind rests on the One sustaining it.
evidence.turn: Carry this with you: let the mind rest on the One already carrying its life.
evidence.practicalImplication: At the sink, desk, or bedside, stop reaching for the next stimulus and feel the breath enter on its own. Let support be received before the mind starts performing again.
